svg.title: CPU needed and CPU given
svg.desc: CPU needed by the offered requests against CPU given by ready pods for each setup, in 20 minutes of repeated peaks, cycles and the sudden jump. Over the whole peaks hour HPA+ request demand was short 0% of the time and gave 2.4 times the CPU needed; the CPU forecast was short 3% and gave 2.7 times; the reactive formula was short 26% and gave 1.6 times.
svg.text: The same 20-minute windows as the CPU-used figure. CPU needed is what the offered requests cost; CPU given is the
pods ready to serve them, 1 CPU each. Below the grey area the pods were short and requests had to wait.
CPU given, in each setup's colour
